name: deluxui
description: UX engineering with a verdict, from the first comp to the release gate: a 233-rule interface contract, 183 static checks, a browser tier that forces the offline/empty/failed states nobody tests, 38 iOS and Android rules with Simulator and emulator evidence, comps rendered from the declared contract and measured back against it, a decision page that refuses an unsigned approval, a phase gate that refuses UI edits until one exists, and a release gate where NOT_RUN never counts as a pass.
